id./param/scenario/cs/a_100_cs_110.pack|cs_: "Whoa?! Oh, it's you. I thought some bad guy was following me.
"It's a dangerous time with these missing persons cases lately, right? I was a bit on edge. Sorry for startling you.
"Well, no use talking out here. Come on inside.
"This is an important guest. Don't get in the way and be good, all right?
"This is the orphanage where I was born and raised. I manage somehow with the prize money I earn at the tourney.
"I have to keep winning and winning at the tourney to earn the prize money. Those kids' smiles are everything to me.
"Well, with a skilled fighter like you around, we'll surely win again this time. Ha ha! I'm counting on you, partner!
{var:1} listened to Vince's rambling talk for a good while.
"Whoa... Is it this late already? Sorry, sorry. I got carried away talking.
"By the way, {var:1}. Didn't you come here because you wanted something from me...
"Just now, I thought I heard a noise from my room...
"No doubt about it! Someone's in my room!
